No other insert or update into `sys_metadata_activation` exists outside the shared store in `core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.ts`. Three writer sites write four values, as revision 3 states.

Door probes: `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/capability/showcase.export_data {"enabled": false}` 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` `Path must be /security/_activation/:type/:name, with :type one of position, permission`; `…/position/everyone` 400 `Position 'everyone' is an audience anchor: … not switchable through this door (ADR-0090 D5/D9)`.
